title: Li2S/C/SnS2 composite-based cathode materials for lithium–sulfur batteries
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00206K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Irshad Mohammad, Akzhan Bekzhanov, Yuri Surace, Damian Cupid
This study explores the synergistic effect of combining carbon black and SnS2 additives with Li2S cathodes, prepared via ball milling, to significantly enhance the cycling performance of Li–S batteries.
